sentences: But the work area with the AI's notes and programs carried over to the next hour
Those that had taken a detour were now one step ahead
A discovery that is not useful now might be a useful card to play next time, if it is saved
One tip in the strategy notes was worth paying attention to
Then one AI made its own obstacle course

items.source_sentence: But the work area with the AI's notes and programs carried over to the next hour
items.source_sentence_ja: しかし、AIのメモやプログラムがある作業エリアは、次の1時間にも引き継がれた。

items.source_sentence: Those that had taken a detour were now one step ahead
items.source_sentence_ja: 遠回りをしたものたちは、今や一歩先を行っていた。

items.source_sentence: A discovery that is not useful now might be a useful card to play next time, if it is saved
items.source_sentence_ja: 今は役に立たない発見でも、保存しておけば、次回に使える切り札になるかもしれない。

items.source_sentence: One tip in the strategy notes was worth paying attention to
items.source_sentence_ja: 戦略メモにあったヒントの一つは、注目する価値があった。

items.source_sentence: Then one AI made its own obstacle course
items.source_sentence_ja: その後、あるAIは自分で障害物コースを作った。
